expectation: Membrane/surface ring on macrophages (M2-like, often a subset of CD163+ cells), plus some dendritic and endothelial cells. Moderately common: scattered single cells or loose clusters in stroma and around vessels, not on tumour or epithelium.
observed: A: scattered cell-sized yellow spots across most ROIs; one ROI has large confluent bright patches. B, C: nearly empty. D: clear membrane rings around nuclei. E: CD206 cells are discrete but dim, and mostly beside rather than on the CD163 cells (little white).
why: Discrete cells with membrane rings appear scattered in stroma across many ROIs, the pattern expected of macrophages, not haze or grain.
notes: CD206 marks scattered cells with membrane rings across most ROIs. Overlap with CD163 in row E is limited. One ROI has large confluent patches, which may be dense macrophage areas or an artefact and are worth a look.
